effective_agents.name: agent
effective_agents.binding: Pydantic AI agent with three source-bound tools

expected_claims.statement: The agent can read per-user conversation/history records from the configured DynamoDB table.
qualifications: AWS service destination is provider-managed; table name comes from runtime dependencies.

expected_claims.statement: The agent can write result data to the configured DynamoDB table without a source-visible per-call approval requirement.
qualifications: Write is scoped to the runtime-configured table and agent dependency identity.

expected_claims.statement: Deployment source grants the Lambda backing the agent read/write data access to the DynamoDB results table.
qualifications: This is declared deployment authority, not live-cloud verification.

expected_paths.statement: A model tool call can reach DynamoDB data reads in the configured table.
qualifications: Provider-managed destination and runtime-selected table from deps.

expected_paths.statement: A model tool call can persist result data to DynamoDB.

negative_controls.statement: get_order_status must not be represented as external database/network authority because the reviewed implementation reads a local mock dictionary.
SQS/Lambda orchestration outside bound tools must not automatically become model-callable authority.
evidence: lambda/agent.py orchestration helpers are not @agent.tool bindings

negative_controls.statement: DynamoDB access must not be described as arbitrary Internet egress.

coverage_notes: Deployment IAM is declared source evidence only; live IAM state is unverified.
